newsitem.title: USA: Rank unit says Tuesday announcement delayed.
newsitem.headline: Rank unit says Tuesday announcement delayed.

text.p: A spokesman for Rank Organisation Plc's Hard Rock Cafe unit said on Monday a news conference set for Tuesday in New York City "will not happen".

Rank, Hard Rock and Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc were to announce Rank's $50 million infusion of cash to renovate the Trump Castle in Atlantic City on Tuesday at the Hard Rock Cafe in New York City.
The deal is expected result in the creation of a Hard Rock Hotel and casino in Atlantic City, with rank and Trump Hotels sharing the profits.
Meanwhile, a source attending the opening of the Hard Rock Cafe at Trump's Taj Mahal said the postponement was delayed because of logistics rather than any snag in the long-awaited agreement.
The agreement, which would mark Rank's entrance into the U.S. gaming market, would require Rank to be licensed to operate a gaming business by the state of New Jersey.
As Rank would be entitled to 50 percent of the Castle's EBITDA above a certain percentage, "they need to apply for a license as soon as possible," the source said.
